written.headline: Palo Alto Networks in talks to buy AI security startup Clutch Security for $500 million
written.summary: Palo Alto Networks is negotiating to acquire Israeli startup Clutch Security, which builds software to track passwords used by AI agents, for roughly $500 million. The deal would bring AI‑focused security tools into Palo Alto’s portfolio.

written.headline: Qualcomm aims for $5 billion in AI data‑center revenue in fiscal 2027
written.summary: Qualcomm reported $650 million in data‑center revenue for Q4 2026 and said it targets $5 billion in fiscal 2027, rising to $15 billion by 2029, as smartphone chip sales fall.

written.headline: OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer, adding developer tools to Codex
written.summary: OpenAI announced it will acquire Pierre Computer Company, the maker of open‑source tools such as Trees and Diffs, to expand its Codex platform’s code‑navigation and review capabilities. The deal is subject to customary closing conditions, including regulatory approvals.

written.headline: D3D method boosts speculative decoding speed up to 7.5× on Qwen3 models
written.summary: Researchers introduced D3D, a diffusion drafter that removes inter‑round dependencies, achieving up to 7.48× speedup on GSM8K with Qwen3‑32B and averaging 5.00×–5.71× across seven benchmarks.

written.headline: Midterm results boost opposition to AI data centers, prompting new restrictions
written.summary: Democrats gained control of Congress in the November 2026 midterms, while exit polls showed 76‑80% of voters opposed AI data centers in their neighborhoods. The vote led to dozens of local ballot measures restricting or banning large data centers, and analysts expect new construction moratoriums and stricter community cost rules.
